language_task: Pick up the spoon and place it into the box.
outcome_evidence: The spoon is initially on the table (frame 0, ceiling and wrist_left). The robot grasps and lifts it clear of the table (frames 36–42, wrist_left), carries it to the blue box, and releases it inside (frames 69–74, wrist_right). After the gripper withdraws, the spoon remains visibly inside the box (frames 89–92, ceiling). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
